sources.name: USFQ - Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital (HDEV)

sources.name: USFQ - TUERI Wildlife Hospital

entries.name: Clinica Veterinaria Municipal Urbanimal
entries.address: Francisco Fuertes and Gaspar Cujias, San Bartolo, south Quito
entries.duty: Free municipal clinic. Consultations Monday to Friday 08:00-16:30. Call ahead for emergencies.
entries.note: News article (2023, republished 2026) says animals are received 24 hours a day but consultations are Mon-Fri 08:00-16:30; inconsistent, so emergency_24h left false. Street 'Fuertes' also spelled 'Fuentes'. Official Quito Bienestar Animal page not opened.

duty_i18n.it: Clinica comunale gratuita. Visite dal lunedì al venerdì 08:00–16:30. Telefonare in anticipo per le emergenze.
duty_i18n.pt: Clínica municipal gratuita. Consultas de segunda a sexta 8h00–16h30. Liga antes para urgências.
duty_i18n.nl: Gratis gemeentelijke kliniek. Consulten maandag tot en met vrijdag 08.00–16.30 uur. Bel vooraf bij spoedgevallen.
duty_i18n.pl: Bezpłatna przychodnia miejska. Konsultacje pon.–pt. 08:00–16:30. W nagłych przypadkach zadzwoń przed wizytą.
duty_i18n.cs: Bezplatná městská klinika. Ordinace Po–Pá 8:00–16:30. V naléhavých případech před cestou zavolejte.
duty_i18n.sv: Kostnadsfri kommunal klinik. Mottagning måndag–fredag 08.00–16.30. Ring innan du kommer vid akutfall.
duty_i18n.da: Gratis kommunal klinik. Konsultation mandag til fredag 08.00–16.30. Ring på forhånd ved akutte tilfælde.
duty_i18n.fi: Ilmainen kunnallinen klinikka. Vastaanotto ma–pe klo 8.00–16.30. Soita päivystystapauksissa etukäteen.
duty_i18n.nb: Gratis kommunal klinikk. Konsultasjoner mandag til fredag kl. 8.00–16.30. Ring på forhånd ved nødtilfeller.
duty_i18n.sl: Brezplačna občinska klinika. Pregledi od ponedeljka do petka 8–16.30. Za nujno pomoč vnaprej pokličite.
duty_i18n.hr: Besplatna gradska klinika. Pregledi pon–pet 08:00–16:30. Za hitne slučajeve nazovi unaprijed.

entries.name: Clinica Veterinaria de la Universidad Central del Ecuador
entries.duty: Open Monday to Friday 08:00-16:00; patients accepted until about 15:00, no appointment needed. Has an emergency area; no night service stated.
entries.note: Only a news article; no address or phone. University site not opened.

duty_i18n.it: Aperto dal lunedì al venerdì 08:00–16:00; pazienti accettati fino alle 15:00 circa, senza appuntamento. Dispone di un'area emergenze; nessun servizio notturno indicato.
duty_i18n.pt: Aberto de segunda a sexta 8h00–16h00; atende até cerca das 15h00, sem marcação. Tem área de urgência; não indica serviço noturno.
duty_i18n.nl: Open maandag tot en met vrijdag 08.00–16.00 uur; patiënten worden tot ongeveer 15.00 uur aangenomen, geen afspraak nodig. Heeft een spoedafdeling; geen nachtdienst vermeld.
duty_i18n.pl: Czynne pon.–pt. 08:00–16:00; pacjenci przyjmowani do ok. 15:00, bez umawiania wizyt. Ma oddział nagłych przypadków; nie podano dyżuru nocnego.
duty_i18n.cs: Otevřeno Po–Pá 8:00–16:00; pacienti se přijímají do cca 15:00, bez objednání. Má pohotovostní část; noční služba není uvedena.
duty_i18n.sv: Öppet måndag–fredag 08.00–16.00; patienter tas emot till cirka 15.00, ingen tidsbokning behövs. Har akutavdelning; ingen nattjänst angiven.
duty_i18n.da: Åbent mandag til fredag 08.00–16.00; patienter tages imod til ca. 15.00, ingen tidsbestilling nødvendig. Har et akutområde; ingen natvagt oplyst.
duty_i18n.fi: Auki ma–pe klo 8.00–16.00; potilaita otetaan vastaan noin klo 15 asti, ajanvarausta ei tarvita. Klinikalla on päivystysosasto; yöpäivystystä ei ole ilmoitettu.
duty_i18n.nb: Åpent mandag til fredag 08.00–16.00; pasienter tas imot til ca. 15.00, ingen timebestilling nødvendig. Har et akuttområde; ingen nattjeneste oppgitt.
duty_i18n.sl: Odprto od ponedeljka do petka 8–16; sprejem do približno 15, naročanje ni potrebno. Ima prostor za nujne primere; nočna služba ni navedena.
duty_i18n.hr: Radi pon–pet 08:00–16:00; pacijenti se primaju do oko 15:00, bez termina. Ima hitni prijem; noćna služba nije navedena.

entries.name: Hospital Municipal de la Mascota
entries.address: Complejo bolivariano, near the Jefferson Perez coliseum, Cuenca
entries.duty: Municipal hospital for dogs and cats. Monday to Friday 08:00-17:00, closed weekends and holidays.

Emergencies for run-over/abandoned pets are covered by an agreement with Fundacion ARCA; no number found. Cuenca Patrulla Canina line 0987050437 (Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00) is a municipal rescue patrol, not listed.

duty_i18n.nl: Gemeentelijk dierenziekenhuis voor honden en katten. Maandag tot en met vrijdag 08.00–17.00 uur, in het weekend en op feestdagen gesloten.

duty_i18n.cs: Městská nemocnice pro psy a kočky. Po–Pá 8:00–17:00, o víkendech a svátcích zavřeno.
duty_i18n.sv: Kommunalt djursjukhus för hundar och katter. Måndag–fredag 08.00–17.00, stängt helger och helgdagar.
duty_i18n.da: Kommunalt hospital for hunde og katte. Mandag til fredag 08.00–17.00, lukket i weekender og på helligdage.
duty_i18n.fi: Kunnallinen koirien ja kissojen sairaala. Ma–pe klo 8.00–17.00, suljettu viikonloppuisin ja pyhäpäivinä.
duty_i18n.nb: Kommunalt dyresykehus for hunder og katter. Mandag til fredag 08.00–17.00, stengt i helger og på helligdager.
duty_i18n.sl: Občinska bolnišnica za pse in mačke. Od ponedeljka do petka 8–17, ob koncih tedna in praznikih zaprto.
duty_i18n.hr: Gradska bolnica za pse i mačke. pon–pet 08:00–17:00, vikendom i blagdanima zatvoreno.

notes: Research 2026-11-12. Few verifiable sources: WebSearch returned mostly news articles and directories; clinics' own websites, Agrocalidad, the Colegio de Medicos Veterinarios and Quito's Unidad de Bienestar Animal did not surface as openable pages with clinic contact data (Quito's registry 'Registra tu Huella' has no public list found). No 24 h private clinic with its own page was found in Quito, Guayaquil or Cuenca; none in Galapagos (Puerto Ayora / San Cristobal), Manta/Salinas/Montanita, Banos, Loja, Ambato (only NGO/charity articles about Galapagos pets, no clinic contact data). No animal poison line found (CIATOX 1800-VENENO is for humans, not listed). No duty rota found. Not entries: Cuenca Patrulla Canina 0987050437, Guayaquil fire-brigade animal rescue via 911, Cuenca clinics named only in blogs/news without phone (Villa Club Animal, D'Pelo Medic, Hospital Veterinario San Francisco, Clinica La Herradura). Guayaquil: no clinic with contact data found (Isla Puna municipal vet unit mentioned without contact).
